content.value_statement: Finished images often lose search and copy support when exported as flat PDFs. This skill adds an aligned text layer while preserving the visual design.
actual_capabilities: Preserves a raster image as the visible PDF background.
Adds selectable, searchable text from a layout file.
Creates a visible debug PDF for text box inspection.
Converts OCR word boxes into line-level layout items.
Accepts bounding boxes, polygons, and relative coordinates.
Supports optional Unicode fonts for non-Latin text.
limitations: Requires OCR output, vision model boxes, or a prepared layout file.
Does not run an OCR engine by itself.
Tiny, rotated, or curved text may need manual layout fixes.
Requires Python dependencies such as PyMuPDF and Pillow.

use_cases.title: Publish Generated Posters
use_cases.description: Turn final poster images into searchable client PDFs without rebuilding the design.

use_cases.title: Prepare Visual Resumes
use_cases.description: Export image-based resumes with copyable text for review and applicant tracking workflows.

use_cases.title: Archive Image Documents
use_cases.description: Add searchable text to scan-like images when exact visual preservation is required.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Searchable PDF
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner conversion from one finished image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill with my finished image at [image path]. Create a searchable PDF and a visible inspection PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Correct OCR Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Use source text to improve copied output.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to build the text layer from OCR output and my source text. Preserve image coordinates and correct OCR wording.

prompt_templates.title: Support Non-Latin Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a searchable PDF with a supplied Unicode font.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a searchable PDF with a Unicode font for CJK text. Report any text that may not extract correctly.

prompt_templates.title: Refine Text Alignment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review using the debug PDF.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect the debug PDF, compare selection areas with the image, and revise boxes until copied text is correct.

output_examples.input: A generated event poster image and corrected event text.
output: The final PDF preserves the poster image exactly.
The text can be selected, copied, and searched.
The debug PDF shows visible text boxes for review.

output_examples.input: A visual resume image, OCR word boxes, and the original resume text.
output: The layout uses OCR positions with corrected resume wording.
The final PDF supports text selection over each resume line.
The inspection PDF highlights areas that need manual adjustment.

output_examples.input: A Chinese poster image and a compatible Unicode font file.
output: The generated PDF embeds selectable non-Latin text.
The debug PDF helps verify each line position.
Warnings identify missing font or extraction issues.

best_practices: Use OCR boxes for position and source text for final wording.
Inspect the visible debug PDF before sharing the hidden text PDF.
Use a Unicode font when the document contains non-Latin text.
anti_patterns: Rebuilding a finished visual design in another format before adding the text layer.
Trusting raw OCR text without comparing it to source content.
Embedding tiny decorative text that users do not need to search or copy.

faq.question: Does this skill perform OCR by itself?
faq.answer: No. It expects OCR output, vision model boxes, or a manually prepared layout file.

faq.question: Will the final PDF look different from the image?
faq.answer: The final PDF keeps the original image as the visible background. The debug PDF adds visible inspection marks.

faq.question: Can users select and copy the text?
faq.answer: Yes, when the layout boxes and text values are accurate.

faq.question: Does it support CJK or other non-Latin text?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a Unicode font file and inspect the output for extraction quality.

faq.question: What files does it create?
faq.answer: It creates a final searchable PDF and can also create a visible debug PDF.

faq.question: What should I do if OCR text is wrong?
faq.answer: Correct the layout text using the source text, while preserving the OCR-derived positions.
